title: LIMOPro: Reasoning Refinement for Efficient and Effective Test-time Scaling
authors_zh: Yang Xiao、Jiashuo Wang、Ruifeng Yuan、Chunpu Xu、Kaishuai Xu、Wenjie Li、Pengfei Liu（机构：香港理工大学、上海交通大学、SII）
paper_type_zh: 高效测试时推理数据与扩展研究
best_for_zh: 希望改善准确率—延迟权衡、但不愿粗暴压缩逻辑解题主线的读者。
one_line: LIMOPro prunes low-importance functional reasoning steps from training traces, producing models that retain or improve accuracy while spending fewer tokens at inference.
LIMOPro 从训练推理轨迹中剪去低重要性的功能性步骤，使模型在测试时以更少词元保持或提高准确率。
why: It ties data-side step pruning to measurable inference-time scaling behavior and separates essential reasoning progress from redundant functional text.
inclusion_reason: It changes the training traces used to produce inference-time reasoning so that future test-time computation focuses on solution-progressing steps rather than redundant verification and correction text.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reasoning models often inherit long chains of thought from powerful teachers. Those traces mix the progressive deductions that actually lead to an answer with functional behavior such as rechecking arithmetic, trying an alternative route, or correcting an earlier attempt. Functional behavior can be valuable for a human solver, but copying every instance into supervision makes a student verbose at inference time and raises latency, token cost, and the chance that a long response drifts away from the essential solution.

The paper asks how to shorten reasoning traces without treating all text as equally disposable. A generic compressor may delete the very deduction that establishes the answer, whereas simply training on the original traces makes a model carry redundant verification and repair loops into every response. The desired training record should preserve the logical backbone of the solution while removing only functional steps whose absence does not materially reduce confidence in the final answer.

推理模型常从强教师继承很长的思维链。这些轨迹混合了真正导向答案的渐进式推导，也混合了复查算术、尝试替代路径或纠正先前尝试等功能性行为。功能性行为对人类解题者可能有价值，但若把每一次都复制进监督数据，学生模型就会在推理时变得冗长，并提高延迟、词元成本以及长回答偏离核心解法的风险。

论文探讨如何缩短推理轨迹，而不把所有文本都视为同样可丢弃。通用压缩器可能删掉建立答案的关键推导；而直接使用原始轨迹训练又会让模型在每次回答中携带冗余的验证与修复循环。理想训练记录应保留解法的逻辑主干，同时只移除那些即使缺失也不会显著降低最终答案置信度的功能性步骤。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
LIMOPro separates four reasoning patterns. Progressive reasoning is the forward solution path and is always retained. Verification, multi-method validation, and error correction are functional patterns that may help, but can also be redundant. The key decision is therefore not to prune by surface length or a fixed position; it is to estimate how much a particular functional step changes the model's confidence in the answer, then remove only the least important eligible steps.

Perplexity-based Importance Refinement, or PIR, makes this decision quantitative. For a step, the method compares answer perplexity with the full reasoning chain and with that step removed. If the omission barely changes answer confidence, the step receives a low importance value and is a candidate for pruning. The resulting refined datasets are used to fine-tune models, so the claimed benefit appears at deployment time as shorter, more effective reasoning rather than as a one-off edit of a teacher response.

LIMOPro 区分四类推理模式。渐进式推理是向前推进的解题路径，会始终保留。验证、多方法验证和错误纠正属于功能性模式，可能有帮助，但也可能冗余。因此关键决策不是按表面长度或固定位置剪枝，而是估计某个功能性步骤对答案置信度究竟产生多大变化，再只移除其中最不重要的步骤。

基于困惑度的重要性细化，即 PIR，使这一决策可量化。对于一个步骤，方法比较完整推理链下的答案困惑度与移除该步骤后的答案困惑度。如果省略几乎不改变答案置信度，该步骤就会得到较低重要性值，并成为剪枝候选。由此得到的细化数据集用于微调模型，所以所声称的收益会在部署时表现为更短、更有效的推理，而不是对某条教师回答的一次性编辑。

title: Method
方法
html:
The pipeline first segments a trace into coherent logical steps. It uses rule-based phrases to identify explicit verification and correction language, then uses Claude 3.7 Sonnet for contextual classification of ambiguous steps. Human evaluation of a random five percent sample reports unanimous agreement with the classification for 93.4% of steps. All progressive steps are kept. For each functional step, Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct calculates answer perplexity with and without the step, and PIR ranks the eligible steps for selective removal.

The authors apply this to three sources: S1K with 1,000 Gemini Thinking traces, LIMO with 817 DeepSeek-R1 traces, and LIMO-V2 with 800 QwQ traces. They construct the corresponding refined sets and fine-tune models on them. Test-time evaluation measures pass@1 accuracy, average response tokens, and their efficiency ratio on AIME24, AMC23, and GPQA Diamond. It also varies response budgets from 2k to 24k tokens to check whether the refined models retain useful scaling behavior rather than merely performing well at one fixed length.

流程首先把轨迹切分为连贯的逻辑步骤。它利用基于规则的短语识别显式验证与纠正语言，再用 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 对模糊步骤进行上下文分类。对随机抽取的百分之五样本的人类评估显示，93.4% 的步骤获得了对分类的一致同意。所有渐进式步骤都会保留。对于每个功能性步骤，Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 分别在保留和移除该步骤时计算答案困惑度，PIR 据此为可剪步骤排序。

作者将此应用于三种来源：含 1,000 条 Gemini Thinking 轨迹的 S1K、含 817 条 DeepSeek-R1 轨迹的 LIMO，以及含 800 条 QwQ 轨迹的 LIMO-V2，并构建对应的细化集合来微调模型。测试时评估在 AIME24、AMC23 和 GPQA Diamond 上测量 pass@1、平均输出词元及其效率比。它还将回答预算从 2k 改变到 24k，检查细化模型是否保留有用的扩展行为，而不是只在一个固定长度上表现良好。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
For the LIMO source, the refined LIMO-P model improves AIME pass@1 from 56.7% to 63.3% while reducing average response tokens from 12,497 to 10,588. On AMC it moves from 91.9% to 93.8% with five percent fewer tokens, and on GPQA Diamond it moves from 67.2% to 71.2% with three percent fewer tokens. Across the reported datasets and source models, the paper summarizes accuracy gains of 0.9% to 6.6% and token reductions of 3% to 41%, with up to 71% improvement in its efficiency measure.

The results are not limited to one teacher source or one budget. The paper reports gains for data refined from DeepSeek-R1, Gemini Thinking, and QwQ, and presents scaling curves from 2k through 24k response-token limits. The LIMO-P curves maintain an advantage over the original LIMO at the shown budgets, supporting the claim that pruning removed low-value functional text instead of simply depriving the student of useful deliberation. The step-label validation is also relevant evidence, because the method's selective guarantee depends on separating progressive from functional content.

对于 LIMO 来源，细化后的 LIMO-P 模型将 AIME 的 pass@1 从 56.7% 提升到 63.3%，同时把平均输出词元从 12,497 降至 10,588。在 AMC 上，它从 91.9% 升至 93.8%，词元减少百分之五；在 GPQA Diamond 上，它从 67.2% 升至 71.2%，词元减少百分之三。跨报告的数据集和源模型，论文总结准确率提升为 0.9% 到 6.6%，词元减少为 3% 到 41%，效率指标最多提升 71%。

结果并不局限于一个教师来源或一个预算。论文报告了从 DeepSeek-R1、Gemini Thinking 和 QwQ 细化数据的收益，并给出从 2k 到 24k 输出词元限制的扩展曲线。LIMO-P 曲线在展示的预算下保持对原始 LIMO 的优势，支持“剪掉的是低价值功能文本，而不是剥夺学生有用审慎推理”的主张。步骤标签验证也是相关证据，因为方法的选择性保证依赖于区分渐进式内容与功能性内容。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper's novelty is to preserve a semantic class of reasoning steps by default and optimize another class with a counterfactual answer-confidence test. It does not equate concise reasoning with deleting the lowest-probability text. A verification or correction step can remain if removing it raises answer perplexity, whereas an eloquent-looking step can be removed if it has little causal contribution under the metric. This is a more targeted decision rule than length truncation or whole-trace filtering.

LIMOPro also connects curation decisions to a deployed inference outcome. The pruning happens before fine-tuning, but the evaluation explicitly asks whether models trained on refined data scale better under larger response budgets. That connection makes the work relevant to test-time compute rather than only to dataset compression: the objective is not the smallest trace, but a learned reasoning policy that spends its eventual inference tokens on steps that move the solution forward.

论文的新意是默认保留一类语义推理步骤，并用反事实的答案置信度测试来优化另一类步骤。它不把简洁推理等同于删除概率最低的文本。一个验证或纠正步骤若被移除后提高了答案困惑度，就可以保留；一个表述漂亮的步骤若在该指标下几乎没有因果贡献，则可以移除。这比按长度截断或过滤整条轨迹更有针对性。

LIMOPro 还把数据整理决策与部署后的推理结果相连接。剪枝发生在微调之前，但评测明确追问：在更大的回答预算下，使用细化数据训练的模型是否扩展得更好。这种连接使工作与测试时计算相关，而不只是数据集压缩：目标不是得到最短轨迹，而是学习一种在未来推理时把词元花在推进解法步骤上的推理策略。

title: Limitations
局限
html: PIR measures importance through the answer perplexity of a particular evaluator, not through a proof of causal necessity. Its step segmentation and functional labels can be wrong, and a low-PIR step can still matter for interpretability, robustness, or a future branch that the chosen answer does not reveal. Preserving all progressive steps may retain unnecessary text, while tuning a pruning ratio creates another trade-off. The method is evaluated on relatively structured reasoning traces and may transfer less cleanly to tool calls, interactive agents, or tasks where validation steps carry external safety value.
PIR 通过特定评估模型的答案困惑度测量重要性，而不是通过因果必要性的证明。其步骤切分和功能性标签可能出错，低 PIR 步骤仍可能对可解释性、鲁棒性或最终答案未呈现的未来分支有价值。保留全部渐进式步骤也可能留下不必要文本，而调节剪枝比例又引入新的权衡。方法在较结构化的推理轨迹上评估，向工具调用、交互智能体或验证步骤具有外部安全价值的任务迁移时，可能不那么直接。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a reasoning model is accurate but expensive because its fine-tuning traces teach it to repeatedly verify and restart. It provides a concrete curation audit: inspect the proportion of progressive, verification, alternative-method, and correction text; test removal by answer confidence rather than by phrase length; and evaluate the resulting model across several token budgets. In production, retain a separate safety or tool-verification path for cases where a functional step is externally required, even if it appears removable for benchmark accuracy.
当推理模型很准确却很昂贵，因为其微调轨迹教会它反复验证和重新开始时，可参考本工作。它给出具体的数据整理审计：检查渐进式、验证、替代方法和纠正文本的比例；按答案置信度而非短语长度测试移除；并在多个词元预算下评估得到的模型。在生产中，对于功能性步骤在外部上必需的场景，即使它看似可为基准准确率而删除，也应保留独立的安全或工具验证路径。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The paper is a bridge between reasoning-data design and inference-time scaling. Its intervention occurs offline, but its selection criterion is explicitly chosen for the future answer-generation distribution, and the reported success criterion is a better accuracy-token curve after fine-tuning. Read the efficiency ratios alongside the raw accuracy and token counts, and do not assume that a refined trace is automatically safer or more faithful. The relevant comparison is a model trained under the same source, size, and inference budget, with only the step-selection rule changed.
这篇论文是推理数据设计与推理时扩展之间的桥梁。其干预发生在离线阶段，但选择标准明确面向未来答案生成分布，报告的成功标准也是微调后更好的准确率—词元曲线。应将效率比与原始准确率和词元数一起阅读，不要假设细化轨迹天然更安全或更忠实。相关比较应是源数据、模型规模和推理预算都相同，只改变步骤选择规则的模型。
